data.standardized_narrative: Balance sheet shows gross claims outstanding at 31 December 2015 (the opening reserves for 2016) of approximately 25.587 million (presented in the 2015 comparative column). The report contains references to an open year profit release for 2015, indicating favourable prior-year development, however no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' (insurance liabilities column) figure could be confidently located in the visible notes. As a result the quantified prior-year development (gross) is not extractable from the provided pages with high confidence.
raw_causal_phrases: The directors propose a $25.3 million open year profit release to the members of the 2015 year of account.
data.data_quality_notes: Extraction limitations: scanning/rotation and low image clarity prevented reliable reading of the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note (gross insurance liabilities column). Balance sheet gross claims outstanding (2015 comparative) was readable enough to extract (25,587 in thousands). No explicit gross prior-year development (Insurance liabilities column) figure was unambiguously found; narrative references to a 2015 open-year profit release were located but these appear to be net/YOA distribution commentary rather than a clear gross PY movement line. Segmental premium breakdown and a clear gross claims development triangle exist in the report images but were not legibly extractable with confidence from the provided images; hence those fields are left null. Currency displayed in the statements uses the '$' symbol in the scanned pages; report currency set to USD accordingly. Users should verify with the original PDF for precise gross PY movement and the full claims development triangle.
